samples: the wood . he reached down in his mind , as if he reached for the world . he sits on the air . he thought about the sky , slow and clear . he reached for a pull . the balloon floats above , next . he did not change , and smooth , not even the branch above
note: Descriptive, and at this corpus size the samples are expected to be poor. Admissibility is deliberately not reported: the tokeniser is built from the level's lexicon, so every token the model can emit is admissible by construction and the figure would be one hundred per cent whatever the model learned.
